alex: Ran an Nsight timeline on the TP=2 / PP=1 run for the rescaled model. Seeing repeated all-reduce spikes around step ~120 and long idle gaps on GPU1. nvprof shows a kernel-selection flip (fp16 -> int8 path) right before the stalls. capture: https://internal/nsight/capture/1965432100
priya: can you paste the launch args and the kernel-selection logs? curious if it's a batch-shape thing or kv-cache warmup mismatch
alex: launch: ```./serve --tp=2 --pp=1 --batch_limit=32 --adaptive-kernel=true --kv-cache=on --quant-profile=dynamic```
kevent: kernel-selection logs (trimmed): ```kernel_select: step=118 chosen=fp16_fast estimated_ms=0.9
kernel_select: step=119 chosen=int8_fast estimated_ms=0.6
kernel_select: step=120 chosen=fp16_fallback estimated_ms=1.8```
ben: hm that "fp16_fallback" at 120 looks like a shape/stride mismatch fallback. we saw similar when kv-cache growth changed sequence lengths and the autotuner picked a slower path. could be batching heuristic oscillation too.
sasha: added perf-bot summary: allreduce p2p median=420us, tail=3.1ms; kernel launch skew on GPU1 ~600us; avg comm/compute overlap=0.18 (bad).
perf-bot: Automated note: recent deploy (commit f2a9b2) toggled adaptive-kernel default -> true for this model family. Correlates with perf jump in week window.
priya: I suspect kv-cache warmup increases effective seq_len for certain batches, which nudges the kernel selector into a fallback. that + larger microbatches cause allreduce to serialize more.
alex: repro plan: 1) disable adaptive-kernel (force fp16_fast) 2) run nsight capture for 500 steps with constant microbatch=4 vs microbatch=16 3) enable custom timers (comm/compute counters) to capture overlap metric.
ben: quick snippet for a lightweight comm/compute overlap metric we can push into telemetry: ```// per-step micro-timers
start_compute = now_us(); run_compute(); end_compute = now_us();
start_comm = now_us(); run_allreduce(); end_comm = now_us();
compute_time = end_compute - start_compute; comm_time = end_comm - start_comm;
overlap_est = max(0, compute_time + comm_time - step_time) / step_time; // fraction overlapped```
priya: also add a hot-path check for kv-cache size change: log when cache_entries changes > 8 between steps. that will confirm warmup hypothesis.
sasha: I'll schedule two captures on the staging cluster tonight: (A) adaptive-kernel=false microbatch=4, (B) adaptive-kernel=true microbatch=16. will attach nsight timeline + nvprof sampling.
alex: If A removes the stalls, then adaptive-kernel needs a guard when kv-cache growth detected. Could also add hysteresis for kernel selector or prefer stable kernels during rollout.
ben: small experiment suggestion: add a "kernel-stability" score that penalizes selectors that flip within N steps; prefer the stable choice even if slightly slower to avoid allreduce churn.
perf-bot: Note: add a custom histogram for "kernel_flip_rate" per model-version (tags: tp,pp,quant).
priya: ok sounds good. next steps: sasha runs captures, alex prepares a diff to force a stable kernel flag + kv-cache-change detector, ben will prototype kernel-stability scoring, perf-bot will ingest new metrics. Meet tomorrow 10:30 to review timelines. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks, assigning follow-ups: sasha -> run captures + upload traces; alex -> kernel-flag diff; ben -> prototype scoring; priya -> kv-cache detector instrumentation.
sasha: acknowledged, will upload capture links as soon as done)
